newsitem.title: GREECE: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK ENTERS EU JOP-PHARE PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK ENTERS EU JOP-PHARE PROGRAMME.

text.p: State Macedonia-Thrace Bank signed a framework agreement with the European Commission, participating in the JOP-PHARE-TACIS financial intermediaries network, it announced on Monday.

Under the framework agreement, Macedonia-Thrace Bank will be promoting investments in the Russian federation, central and eastern European countries, aimed especially at setting up joint ventures with EU partners.
"The framework agreement expands the bank's Balkan perspective and complements its business platform," said Macedonia-Thrace Bank president Spyros Kouniakis.

Small-to-medium size businesses of EU member countries may seek financing for joint ventures in all business sectors including commercial activities, services and manufacturing. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
